You can ask an organisation for a copy o: O le beere fun ajọ kan fun ẹda data ti ara ẹni ti o ni nipa rẹ
You can ask them to correct wrong or inc: O le beere lọwọ wọn lati ṣatunṣe aṣiṣe tabi data ti ko pe
You can ask them to delete your data in: O le beere lọwọ wọn lati pa data rẹ ni awọn ipo kan
You can ask them to limit how they use y: O le beere lọwọ wọn lati ṣe idinwo bi wọn ṣe lo data rẹ ni awọn ipo kan
You can ask for your data in a form you: O le beere fun data rẹ ni fọọmu ti o le mu lọ si olupese miiran
You can object to some uses, including d: O le tako diẹ ninu awọn lilo, pẹlu tita taara
You can challenge some decisions made ab: O le koju diẹ ninu awọn ipinnu ti o ṣe nipa rẹ nipasẹ kọnputa nikan
You can report a breach of your rights t: O le jabo irufin awọn ẹtọ rẹ si NDPC
You do not need a lawyer to use these ri: O ko nilo agbẹjọro lati lo awọn ẹtọ wọnyi. Ifiranṣẹ ti o han gbangba, oniwa rere ti o lorukọ ofin, sọ gangan ohun ti o fẹ, ti o fun ajo ni ọna lati dahun nigbagbogbo to lati bẹrẹ. Awọn ile-iṣẹ tun ni awọn iṣẹ labẹ Ofin, gẹgẹbi titọju data rẹ ni aabo ati gbigba ohun ti wọn nilo nikan fun idi ti a sọ.
How to use your rights: Bii o ṣe le lo awọn ẹtọ rẹ
Keep copies and dates: Tọju awọn adakọ ati awọn ọjọ
Start with the organisation itself; a cl: Bẹrẹ pẹlu agbari funrararẹ; igbasilẹ kikọ ti o han gbangba jẹ ki ẹdun eyikeyi nigbamii ni okun sii.
Start with the organisation that holds y: Bẹrẹ pẹlu ajo ti o di data rẹ mu tabi pese iṣẹ naa. Lo imeeli osise rẹ, apakan iranlọwọ app tabi laini itọju alabara, fi ibeere rẹ si kikọ ki o ni igbasilẹ kan. Tọju awọn sikirinisoti, awọn ọjọ ati awọn nọmba itọkasi. Ti ko ba dahun tabi ko ṣe atunṣe iṣoro naa, mu ẹdun naa lọ si olutọsọna ti o tọ: NDPC fun ilokulo data ti ara ẹni, Nigerian Communications Commission (NCC) fun awọn iṣoro pẹlu nẹtiwọki foonu rẹ, tabi Central Bank of Nigeria awọn ikanni Idaabobo onibara fun awọn iṣoro pẹlu awọn ile-ifowopamọ, lẹhin ti o ti fi ẹsun si banki akọkọ. Lo awọn alaye olubasọrọ nikan lori oju opo wẹẹbu osise ti olutọsọna.
